name: io.github.LumabyteCo/clarifyprompt
description: Context-aware AI prompt compiler for 58+ platforms — workspace signal gathering, intent resolution, target-model capability hints, local tracing, custom platforms

environmentVariables.description: LLM API endpoint URL (OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic)
environmentVariables.name: LLM_API_URL

environmentVariables.description: API key for the LLM provider (not needed for local Ollama)
environmentVariables.name: LLM_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Model name/ID to use for optimization
environmentVariables.name: LLM_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Data directory for traces and memory (default: ~/.clarifyprompt, respects XDG_DATA_HOME)
environmentVariables.name: CLARIFYPROMPT_DATA_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Trace mode: off | local | otel (default: local). Traces are strictly local JSONL; nothing is uploaded.
environmentVariables.name: CLARIFYPROMPT_TRACE
